name: duration_microseconds1.k
model:
class PrecisionTest {
  microDuration:Duration

  req microDuration >= 0:00:00.000001

  req microDuration <= 0:00:00.001000
}

class HighPrecisionEvent {
  startOffset:Duration
  endOffset:Duration

  req startOffset = 0:00:00.000500

  req endOffset = 0:00:00.001500

  req endOffset > startOffset
}

class MicrosecondValues {
  oneMicro:Duration
  hundredMicros:Duration
  oneMillis:Duration

  req oneMicro = 0:00:00.000001

  req hundredMicros = 0:00:00.000100

  req oneMillis = 0:00:00.001000

  req oneMicro < hundredMicros

  req hundredMicros < oneMillis
}

test1:PrecisionTest

test2:HighPrecisionEvent

test3:MicrosecondValues
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (test1 Ref)(test2 Ref)(test3 Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((PrecisionTest (mk-PrecisionTest (microDuration Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((HighPrecisionEvent (mk-HighPrecisionEvent (startOffset Int)(endOffset Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((MicrosecondValues (mk-MicrosecondValues (oneMicro Int)(hundredMicros Int)(oneMillis Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-PrecisionTest (sel-PrecisionTest PrecisionTest))
  (lift-HighPrecisionEvent (sel-HighPrecisionEvent HighPrecisionEvent))
  (lift-MicrosecondValues (sel-MicrosecondValues MicrosecondValues))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-PrecisionTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-PrecisionTest (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-PrecisionTest ((this Ref)) PrecisionTest
  (sel-PrecisionTest (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-HighPrecisionEvent ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-HighPrecisionEvent (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-HighPrecisionEvent ((this Ref)) HighPrecisionEvent
  (sel-HighPrecisionEvent (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-MicrosecondValues ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-MicrosecondValues (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-MicrosecondValues ((this Ref)) MicrosecondValues
  (sel-MicrosecondValues (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool

)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-HighPrecisionEvent (TopLevelDeclarations!test2 this))

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

  (deref-isa-MicrosecondValues (TopLevelDeclarations!test3 this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 0) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(assert (! (HighPrecisionEvent.inv2 2) :named _xkassert6))

(assert (! (HighPrecisionEvent.inv3 2) :named _xkassert7))

; ------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-MicrosecondValues MicrosecondValues)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun MicrosecondValues.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (MicrosecondValues!oneMicro this) 1)

(assert (! (MicrosecondValues.inv1 3) :named _xkassert8))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun MicrosecondValues.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (MicrosecondValues!hundredMicros this) 100)

(assert (! (MicrosecondValues.inv2 3) :named _xkassert9))

(assert (! (MicrosecondValues.inv3 3) :named _xkassert10))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun MicrosecondValues.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (< (MicrosecondValues!oneMicro this) (MicrosecondValues!hundredMicros this))

; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-PrecisionTest const-1-PrecisionTest))
        2 (lift-HighPrecisionEvent const-2-HighPrecisionEvent))
        3 (lift-MicrosecondValues const-3-MicrosecondValues))

smtModel:
(define-fun const-3-MicrosecondValues () MicrosecondValues
  (mk-MicrosecondValues 1 100 1000))
(define-fun const-1-PrecisionTest () PrecisionTest
  (mk-PrecisionTest 720))
(define-fun const-2-HighPrecisionEvent () HighPrecisionEvent
  (mk-HighPrecisionEvent 500 1500))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1 2 3))
(define-fun _xkassert7 () Bool
  (> (endOffset (sel-HighPrecisionEvent (select heap 2)))
   (startOffset (sel-HighPrecisionEvent (select heap 2)))))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (test3 (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-MicrosecondValues a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (= (startOffset (sel-HighPrecisionEvent (select heap 2))) 500))
(define-fun _xkassert9 () Bool
  (= (hundredMicros (sel-MicrosecondValues (select heap 3))) 100))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool

  (is-lift-PrecisionTest a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert8 () Bool
  (= (oneMicro (sel-MicrosecondValues (select heap 3))) 1))
(define-fun _xkassert10 () Bool
  (= (oneMillis (sel-MicrosecondValues (select heap 3))) 1000))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (>= (microDuration (sel-PrecisionTest (select heap 1))) 1))
(define-fun _xkassert12 () Bool
  (< (hundredMicros (sel-MicrosecondValues (select heap 3)))
   (oneMillis (sel-MicrosecondValues (select heap 3)))))
(define-fun _xkassert11 () Bool

   (hundredMicros (sel-MicrosecondValues (select heap 3)))))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (= (endOffset (sel-HighPrecisionEvent (select heap 2))) 1500))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (test2 (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-HighPrecisionEvent a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (<= (microDuration (sel-PrecisionTest (select heap 1))) 1000))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         0
                         (lift-TopLevelDeclarations
                           (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1 2 3)))
                  1
                  (lift-PrecisionTest (mk-PrecisionTest 720)))))
  (store (store a!1
                2
                (lift-HighPrecisionEvent (mk-HighPrecisionEvent 500 1500)))
